create table t98_otc_deri_cust_ecr_temp01 stored as orc as
, prov as (select distinct tag_name prov, regexp_replace(tag_name, '(市|省|特别行政区|自治区)$', '') part_prov
and tag_name <> '那曲地区' -- 去除旧数据
and status = '1') t2 on t2.prov_cd = t1.dim_val)
left join prov_city cp on t.reg_city <> '' and (cp.city = t.reg_city or cp.part_city = t.reg_city)
left join prov_city cp2 on t.ofc_city <> '' and (cp2.city = t.ofc_city or cp2.part_city = t.ofc_city)
left join prov p1 on t.reg_prov <> '' and p1.part_prov = t.reg_prov
left join prov p2 on t.ofc_prov <> '' and p2.part_prov = t.ofc_prov
group by client_id) B on A.client_id = B.client_id
group by client_id) B on A.client_id = B.client_id
select distinct t2.dict_category, t1.dict_value, t1.dict_desc, 'OTC' source
and dict_category in('xz','nation') ) t2 on t2.id = t1.dict_category_id
select distinct t2.dict_category, t1.dict_value, t1.dict_desc, 'FICC' source
and dict_category in('xz','nation') ) t2 on t2.id = t1.dict_category_id
insert overwrite table t98_otc_deri_cust_ecr partition (busi_date , source)
when '03' then '产品' end           as            pty_cate
when '222' then 'B类（自然人）'end            as            pvc_type
when '0' then '非一二级交易商' end                client_type_desc
, case A.advisor_cert_type when '01' then '内地身份证'
when '09' then '港澳居民来往内地通行证'
when '10' then '台湾居民来往内地通行证'
when 'A7' then '全国组织机构代码'
when '99' then '其他' end               as         advisor_cert_type
when 'credited' then '经风控部批准可以授信'
, case A.list_attribute when '1' then '是'  when '2' then '否'  end  list_attribute
when 'offline'  then '线下盖章' when 'online' then '线上电签'
when 'false' then '否' else '' end as daily_monitor_margin_trade
AND SRC_SYS_NAME = 'OIS') dict1 on dict1.SRC_CD_VAL = A.industry
and remark = 'OTC_DERIVATIVE_COUNTERPARTY.PROD_TYPE') dict2 on dict2.dw_cd_val = A.prod_type
left join dict dict3 on dict3.dict_category = 'xz' and dict3.source = A.source and dict3.dict_value = A.nature
left join dict dict4 on dict4.dict_category = 'nation' and  dict4.source = A.source and dict4.dict_value = A.register_country
left join review_buffer B on B.client_id = A.client_id
and C.unifiedsocial_code = A.unifiedsocial_code and C.id_kind = nvl(A.id_kind, '')
) D on A.secondray_trader not in ('', '0') and D.client_id=A.secondray_trader
